set.body: Outcome: provide a cheap deterministic candidate-only gate for routine laptop use while preserving the separate large-machine external superiority court. Acceptance criteria: AC-435-01 runs only fixed in-memory analytic reframe4s-motion fixtures and downloads no datasets, invokes no external comparator, and materializes no NIfTI outputs. AC-435-02 checks six-degree-of-freedom recovery, the capture court, pair and application throughput, allocation bounds, and the primitive normal-equation kernel. AC-435-03 a machine-readable definition fixes suites, numeric thresholds, JVM memory, minimum free disk, maximum incremental build growth, and persisted log and receipt budgets. AC-435-04 every run emits a bounded receipt with definition hash, source revision and dirty state, environment, exact command, parsed metrics, failures, and log checksum. AC-435-05 missing diagnostics, nonzero tests, threshold losses, or resource-budget violations fail closed. AC-435-06 documentation states that this gate is regression evidence only and cannot admit or weaken the mig-430 or mig-434 superiority claim; protocol-v2 execution remains deferred to a qualified larger host.
set.title: Add bounded laptop motion accuracy and performance gate
